_note: Plan 100061: mutation contract for close_cycle.py and lens_commit.py — the two 2026-09-09 riders retired as code.

mutants.name: M1-drop-coherence-from-splice-keys
mutants.why: Removing 'coherence' from _SPLICE_KEYS makes _splice_keys raise 'emitter missing keys: coherence' because the emitter outputs it but it's not in the extraction loop. The splice step fails and close_cycle returns 1; test_c1_happy_path expects 0.

mutants.name: M2-no-op-splice-write
mutants.why: Replacing the spliced value with the original line makes the splice a no-op: the plan still carries '<declare>' placeholders. Step 6 STORED==LIVE then sees stored='validation: <declare>' vs live='validation: cycle_check=BAR_MET,...' and fails; test_c1_happy_path expects rc 0.

mutants.name: M3-flip-stored-live-comparison
mutants.why: Flipping != to == in the stored==live guard makes it fail when stored and live MATCH (the happy path) and succeed when they diverge (the tamper case). test_c1_happy_path sees rc 1; test_c4_stored_live_mismatch sees rc 0 instead of 1.

mutants.name: M4-battery-checks-CONTINUE-not-BAR_MET
mutants.why: Changing the battery's cycle_check assertion to look for 'CONTINUE' makes it always fire (cycle_check correctly returns BAR_MET, so the new check's NOT-prefix triggers). Battery always fails; test_c1_happy_path expects rc 0.

mutants.name: M5-lens-assert-self-comparison
mutants.why: Replacing the assert's right-hand side with composed_name makes it a tautology (always equal to itself). When test_l2_assert_checks_name patches LENS_NAMES[3]='WrongName', the script composes 'WrongName' and asserts 'WrongName' != 'WrongName' — False — so no refusal; test_l2 expects rc 1.

mutants.name: M6-yield-rising-ceiling-inverted
mutants.why: Flipping > to < in the walk ceiling check means walk 7 (>6) is no longer refused; the script commits instead. test_l4_yield_rising_walk7_refused expects rc 1 but gets 0.

mutants.name: M7-lint-gate-inverted
mutants.why: Inverting 'SHAPE-OK' not in out to 'SHAPE-OK' in out makes the lint gate refuse when the register IS conformant and pass when it is not. test_l1_subject_lens_name's valid register is refused; rc 1 instead of 0.
